title: Fibre product of universally closed morphisms is universally closed
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $f_1:X_1\to Y_1$ and $f_2:X_2\to Y_2$ be morphisms of schemes over $S$ (that is, $X_i\to S$ and $Y_i\to S$ are given and $f_i$ commutes with them). If $f_1$ and $f_2$ are universally closed [def-weil-proper-morphism], then the induced morphism $f_1\times_Sf_2:X_1\times_SX_2\to Y_1\times_SY_2$ of fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product] is universally closed.

source.place: Morphisms, proof of Lemma 09MQ (lemma-image-universally-closed-separated), first paragraph: the map $X\times_SX\to Y\times_SY$ is universally closed as the composition $X\times_SX\to X\times_SY\to Y\times_SY$ of universally closed morphisms; these are base changes of $f$, universally closed by Lemma 01W4 (lemma-base-change-proper, second sentence), and the composite is universally closed by Lemma 01W3 (lemma-composition-proper, second sentence)
